title: Typed permission names and MCP tools
prompt: src/permissions.ts already defines `access` with Inferlo's permissions(), and GET /notes/stats uses the route option `permission: "notes.stats"`. Register `access` in Inferlo's Register interface in src/models.ts, so the `permission` route option only accepts the permission names defined in src/permissions.ts and a misspelled name is a TypeScript error. Then expose `noteStats` (GET /notes/stats) as an MCP tool for AI agents. Admins must see it in the MCP tools list; users without the "notes.stats" permission must not.
